Project 1 · My first project

NextU

“Compete with your previous self, not others.”

3 Weeks

A productivity app where you compare today with your own past results.

  • Sign up, login, private tasks
  • Add, edit, delete, complete tasks
  • Daily progress and weekly analytics
  • Arabic and English, light and dark
ReactViteTailwindSupabaseGitVercel

NextU · AI Development Journey

Plan first. Then build in phases.

1 · PlanIdea, MVP scope, docs
2 · DesignUI and database design
3 · BuildReact components
4 · ConnectSupabase, Auth, RLS
5 · AnalyseDashboard and analytics
6 · ShipTesting, Git, Vercel

Simple architecture

React + Vite
Supabase JS SDK⇄Supabase
Auth · PostgreSQL
Row Level Security
  • Each user can only read their own tasks (RLS)
  • Stored tasks feed the dashboard statistics
  • I reviewed and tested what AI generated

NextU · Challenges and Results

What was hard. What I learned.

  • Prompts: vague prompts gave vague results, so I learned to be specific
  • Big project: I split the work into phases
  • UI: generated screens needed my improvements
  • Arabic and English: keeping RTL and LTR layouts consistent
  • Auth and RLS: protecting each user’s data
  • Git and deployment: branches and configuration
Testing: I validated features in the browser and with automated tests.

Real screenshots: analytics overview and day-by-day chart.

Currency Converter

Built in a practical lecture with my instructor. It converts currencies with live exchange rates.

Project 3

AERIS Weather

A responsive weather app with current conditions and a 5-day forecast.

Project 4 · My final project

Itqan إتقان

A calm web platform that helps a Quran memorization teacher manage her circle.

  • Teacher login
  • Students and attendance
  • Exams and memorization progress
  • Quran completion, notes, reports
  • Optional student feedback

From learning how to guide AI to building a complete MVP in just 3 days.

Real Challenges Across Projects

Problem → Action → Result

API key security · Currency

ProblemKey could be exposed in browser code
ActionServer-side API proxy and environment config
ResultRequests handled without exposing the key

Invalid API key · AERIS

ProblemWeather requests returned 401 errors
ActionChecked environment config and credentials
ResultAPI communication restored

Edge Function CORS · Itqan

ProblemFeedback failed in production: CORS issue
ActionChecked Supabase logs, fixed allowed origins
ResultLink, submission and dashboard work end-to-end

Auth and RLS · NextU / Itqan

ProblemEach user must see only their own data
ActionConfigured auth and RLS policies
ResultUser-specific access was tested
